name: mdfw-showcase
description: Renders the MDfW product showcase video from comp.html and synthesizes its soundtracks

scripts.chiptune: node synth-chiptune.js && node render.js video videos/mdfw-showcase-chiptune.mp4
scripts.bigbeat: node synth-bigbeat.js && SPEED=7/6 AUDIO=soundtrack-bigbeat.wav node render.js video videos/mdfw-showcase-bigbeat.mp4
scripts.dreampop: node synth-dreampop.js && AUDIO=soundtrack-dreampop.wav node render.js video videos/mdfw-showcase-dreampop.mp4
scripts.metal: node synth-metal.js && AUDIO=soundtrack-metal.wav node render.js video videos/mdfw-showcase-metal.mp4
